vuln.name: CSP Uses unsafe-hashes
vuln.description: The Content-Security-Policy uses 'unsafe-hashes' to allow specific inline event handlers by hash. While more constrained than unsafe-inline, it still permits inline handlers and weakens CSP.
vuln.impact: Inline event handlers are permitted, which keeps a path open for HTML-injection-based XSS even if script injection is blocked.
vuln.recommendation: Move event handlers into external scripts and remove 'unsafe-hashes'.
